author: Vox
description:
HBCUs are having a moment.

Many historically Black colleges and universities have seen record-breaking enrollment numbers in their recent freshman classes. But on the flip side of that surge, Black freshman enrollment is actually down by 27 percent among the top 50 most selective institutions in the United States. And there are some big explanations behind these shifts.

As the landscape of higher education has evolved from the eras of segregation to the civil rights movement to Trump-era racial politics, Black students have had to adapt on college campuses nationwide as government mandates, school policies, and the dismantling of affirmative action have impacted their education over the years. 

Hosted by Kahlil Greene, this video is part of our new series Kahlil Explains that unites Vox’s unique brand of explainer journalism with Greene’s expertise in how politics and culture shape society. This first episode traces the history of HBCUs and the experience of Black college students
title: The HBCU renaissance, explained

author: Vox
description:
Hollywood loves the idea that we’re walking around with most of our brain switched off, just waiting for the right pill to unlock it. Neuroscientist Heather Berlin says that’s not how any of this works. You use all of your brain, all the time. In fact, it’s so busy that it eats up a huge share of your body’s energy. Sorry, Limitless. What brain “fact” did you grow up believing? Watch Unexplainable on Netflix or listen wherever you get your podcasts.

We’re launching the Vox mobile app, the best way to get all of Vox’s journalism in one place. It brings together all of our work — our podcasts, videos, and written stories — into one experience, so you never have to look elsewhere. 

The app is free to download in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. If you’re not already a Vox Member, you’ll also get a 14-day free trial when you sign up! 

Our newsroom is on a mission to help you understand the world, so that you can help build a better one. Every story we publish will land in the Home tab, where you can navigate between Featured stories and the Latest published. For a quick take on what’s important today, check out our Start Here section.

The app’s Video tab is our new way to deliver short videos on the big topics shaping your life. Plus, you’ll find the best of Vox’s longer videos in the Featured Video section in the Home tab, including in-depth explainers and member-exclusive segments from our podcasts.
